title: Collective Intelligence Chain ΓÇö Link Readiness Contract V1
purpose: The Collective Intelligence Chain is the acceptance test for NayaPOWER: if a taught lesson can become a validated Intelligent Block, connect, integrate, checkpoint, be cold-retrieved, recognized as applicable, acted on, verified, and improve collective intelligence, then the system is intelligence rather than storage. This file declares each link and the evidence that must exist for it to be satisfied. It declares NO status. Status is measured by BRAIN/12-ENGINEERING/verify-collective-chain-readiness.py against the real repository.
authority_boundary: This contract measures readiness. It cannot create an Intelligent Block, allocate canonical identity, or satisfy its own links. A link is satisfied only by independently inspectable evidence.
canonical_identity_rule: An Intelligent Block identity may only be allocated by the current canonical governed intelligence-commit boundary. A locally minted id is not an Intelligent Block and can never satisfy L01.

links.name: LESSON -> INTELLIGENT BLOCK
links.requires: A canonical Intelligent Block exists whose identity was allocated by the current governed intelligence-commit runtime for a specific taught lesson.
evidence: an intelligence-commit runtime receipt containing the authoritative intelligent_block_id
an owner-scoped persisted nayanet_intelligent_blocks row for that id
source Event → Intelligent Block lineage preserved in canonical persistence

links.name: VALIDATE
links.requires: The Intelligent Block validates against the canonical machine contract before it may influence anything.
evidence: BRAIN/00-SPEC/BRAIN-MACHINE-CONTRACT-V1.schema.json
a passing validation result for the block

links.name: CONNECT
links.requires: The block carries explicit, provenance-bearing relationships to existing intelligence rather than existing only as a record.
evidence: graph relationships with a canonical relationship type
relationship provenance paths that resolve

links.name: RECONCILE
links.requires: No unresolved contradiction stands between the new block and existing intelligence. Contradiction is surfaced, never silently dropped.
evidence: zero unresolved CONTRADICTS relationships lacking adjudication
an explicit conflict record where conflict exists

links.name: INTEGRATE INTO CORE INTELLIGENCE
links.requires: The block changes the current integrated understanding, not merely the historical record.
evidence: a Core Intelligence projection that includes the block
a before/after difference in the current understanding

links.name: CHECKPOINT
links.requires: A cognitive checkpoint is emitted capturing state, evidence, learning and next action, so a successor can continue.
evidence: a checkpoint record with a receipt
checkpoint status CHECKPOINT_VERIFIED
successor context present

links.name: COLD RETRIEVE
links.requires: A reader with no conversation history retrieves the block from the canonical boundary using canonical identity alone.
evidence: a retrieval by IB id with no session context
retrieval evidence recording the query and result

links.name: RECOGNIZE APPLICABILITY
links.requires: Retrieval distinguishes what applies from what merely resembles, and states why.
evidence: an applicability decision with reasons
exclusions recorded, not silently dropped

links.name: ACT WITHIN AUTHORITY
links.requires: Action is taken, and RETRIEVE did not grant the authority to take it. Authority is re-validated independently after retrieval.
evidence: an action record
an independent authority check with its own evidence
proof that authority was not inherited from the retrieval

links.name: VERIFY
links.requires: The outcome is independently verified. A successful call is not verification, and a receipt proves only the operation the receipt represents.
evidence: a separate verification record
a Causal Verification Object bound to real event/outcome lineage

links.name: IMPROVE COLLECTIVE INTELLIGENCE
links.requires: Verified learning is promoted above CANDIDATE and measurably improves a later held-out task, and the next checkpoint reflects it.
evidence: learning promoted above CANDIDATE with evidence
a held-out task showing measured improvement
a later checkpoint that differs because of the learning

win_definition: Retained intelligence from Naya A causes independently verified, valuable improvement in Naya B's held-out behaviour, without transferring unauthorised power.
anti_false_positive_law: A link may only be reported SATISFIED by inspected evidence. Missing evidence is UNKNOWN, never PASS. Simulation, local id minting, and self-report are not evidence.
